snippet.title: Paper Mages a magic 80’s type Game you didn't know you needed
snippet.description:
Paper Mages has a demo that's available on Steam and the game will be released in the next week or two.

The vibe is 80s dnd, the game is real time platforming strategy. It's pvp, and you and your opponent have the same pool of cards, but they are dealt randomly to you. How you use them, when you use them, and where you use them in the castle, will determine the winner.

It's been 5 years... pretty much since I started making this game...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732120/Paper_Mages/
